items.title: The Limits of Long-Context Reasoning in Automated Bug Fixing
items.title_zh: 自动化缺陷修复中长上下文推理的局限
items.summary: Systematically evaluates long-context code debugging and patch generation on SWE-bench Verified, finding that agentic trajectories succeed mainly through decomposition into short steps: successful runs typically stay under 20k-30k tokens and longer accumulated contexts correlate with lower success. With relevant files placed in a 64k-token context and perfect retrieval recall, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B resolves only 7% and GPT-5-nano none, revealing a gap between nominal and usable context capacity.

items.title: ILION: Deterministic Pre-Execution Safety Gates for Agentic AI Systems
items.title_zh: ILION：面向智能体 AI 系统的确定性执行前安全门
items.summary: ILION is a deterministic pre-execution gate that classifies proposed agent actions as BLOCK or ALLOW through a five-component cascade, requiring no statistical training or labeled data and producing interpretable verdicts at sub-millisecond latency. On the 380-scenario ILION-Bench v2 it reports F1 0.8515 at a mean latency of 143 microseconds, outperforming Lakera Guard, the OpenAI Moderation API and Llama Guard 3.

items.title: Large-scale online deanonymization with LLMs
items.title_zh: 利用 LLM 进行大规模在线去匿名化
items.summary: Shows that LLM agents with full Internet access can re-identify Hacker News users and Anthropic Interviewer participants at high precision from pseudonymous profiles and conversations alone. It also builds a closed-world attack pipeline that extracts identity features, searches candidate matches with semantic embeddings and reasons over top candidates, reaching up to 68% recall at 90% precision versus near 0% for the best non-LLM method.

items.title: Panini: Continual Learning in Token Space via Structured Memory
items.title_zh: Panini：通过结构化记忆在 token 空间进行持续学习
items.summary: Panini is a non-parametric continual-learning framework that keeps the base model fixed and integrates each new document into a Generative Semantic Workspace, an entity- and event-aware network of question-answer pairs, so retrieval traverses the memory rather than verbatim chunks. Across six QA benchmarks it reports the highest average performance, 5-7% above competitive baselines, while using 2-30x fewer answer-context tokens and reducing unsupported answers.

items.title: Adaptive Collaboration of Arena-Based Argumentative LLMs for Explainable and Contestable Legal Reasoning
items.title_zh: 基于竞技场论辩 LLM 的自适应协作：可解释且可质疑的法律推理
items.summary: ACAL is a neuro-symbolic framework that combines adaptive multi-agent collaboration with an Arena-based Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework, deploying expert agent teams, resolving clashes between claims and escalating borderline cases under uncertainty. It adds a human-in-the-loop workflow that lets users audit and edit the reasoning graph, and reports gains over strong baselines on LegalBench with Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite and Gemini-2.5-Flash.

items.title: AIC CTU@AVerImaTeC: dual-retriever RAG for image-text fact checking
items.title_zh: AIC CTU@AVerImaTeC：面向图文事实核查的双检索器 RAG
items.summary: The team's third-place AVerImaTeC system combines a textual similarity retrieval module, an API-based reverse image search module and a GPT-5.1 generation module, using a single multimodal LLM call per fact-check at an average cost of $0.013. The authors release code, prompts and vector stores as a reproducible starting point.

items.title: Decision Quality Evaluation Framework at Pinterest
items.title_zh: Pinterest 的决策质量评估框架
items.summary: Describes a decision quality evaluation framework deployed at Pinterest, centered on a subject-matter-expert-curated Golden Set and an automated propensity-score sampling pipeline that expands dataset coverage. The framework is used to benchmark LLM agent cost-performance, guide data-driven prompt optimization, manage policy evolution and continuously validate prevalence metrics.

items.title: MedProbCLIP: Probabilistic Adaptation of Vision-Language Foundation Model for Reliable Radiograph-Report Retrieval
items.title_zh: MedProbCLIP：面向可靠影像-报告检索的视觉语言基础模型概率化适配
items.summary: MedProbCLIP models chest X-ray and radiology-report representations as Gaussian embeddings through a probabilistic contrastive objective, adding a variational information bottleneck and multi-view, multi-section encodings during training. On MIMIC-CXR it outperforms CLIP, CXR-CLIP and PCME++ in retrieval and zero-shot classification, with better calibration and robustness to clinically relevant corruptions.

items.title: Automating Agent Hijacking via Structural Template Injection
items.title_zh: 通过结构化模板注入实现智能体劫持自动化
items.summary: Phantom is an automated agent-hijacking framework that injects optimized structured templates into retrieved context to induce role confusion among system, user, assistant and tool instructions. Tests on Qwen, GPT and Gemini show gains in attack success rate and query efficiency, and the authors report more than 70 vulnerabilities confirmed by vendors.

items.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation of Literature-derived Polymer Knowledge: The Example of a Biodegradable Polymer Expert System
items.title_zh: 文献来源高分子知识的检索增强生成：可降解高分子专家系统案例
items.summary: Builds VectorRAG and GraphRAG pipelines over more than 1,000 polyhydroxyalkanoate papers, using context-preserving paragraph embeddings and a canonicalized knowledge graph with entity disambiguation and multi-hop reasoning. GraphRAG shows higher precision and interpretability while VectorRAG gives broader recall, and expert validation finds the tailored pipelines produce well-grounded, citation-reliable answers.

items.title: Catastrophic Forgetting Resilient One-Shot Incremental Federated Learning
items.title_zh: 抗灾难性遗忘的单轮增量联邦学习
items.summary: OSI-FL is a one-shot incremental federated learning framework that sends category-specific embeddings from a frozen vision-language model in a single communication round, then uses a pretrained diffusion model at the server to synthesize client-like data. Selective Sample Retention keeps the most informative samples per category and task to bound forgetting, and the method outperforms traditional and one-shot federated baselines in class- and domain-incremental settings.

items.title: Ontology-Guided Neuro-Symbolic Inference: Grounding Language Models with Mathematical Domain Knowledge
items.title_zh: 本体引导的神经符号推理：以数学领域知识为语言模型提供依据
items.summary: Implements a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses the OpenMath ontology with hybrid retrieval and cross-encoder reranking to inject relevant definitions into prompts, evaluated on the MATH benchmark with three open-source models. Ontology-guided context improves performance when retrieval quality is high, while irrelevant context actively degrades it.

items.title: RVR: Retrieve-Verify-Retrieve for Comprehensive Question Answering
items.title_zh: RVR：面向全面问答的检索-验证-再检索
items.summary: RVR is a multi-round retrieve-verify-retrieve framework in which a verifier selects a high-quality subset of candidate documents and later rounds augment the query with verified documents to uncover answers not yet covered. It reports at least 10% relative and 3% absolute gains in complete recall on QAMPARI and consistent gains on QUEST and WebQuestionsSP across base retrievers.

items.title: INDUCTION: Finite-Structure Concept Synthesis in First-Order Logic
items.title_zh: INDUCTION：一阶逻辑中的有限结构概念合成
items.summary: INDUCTION is a benchmark for finite-structure concept synthesis in first-order logic, where a model must output one formula that explains a target predicate across small relational worlds and is checked by exact model checking. The authors report sharp difficulty gradients and find that low-bloat formulas generalize better to held-out worlds.

items.title: Whisper: Courtside Edition Enhancing ASR Performance Through LLM-Driven Context Generation
items.title_zh: Whisper：Courtside Edition——通过 LLM 驱动上下文生成提升 ASR 性能
items.summary: The paper introduces Whisper: Courtside Edition, a multi-agent LLM pipeline that improves OpenAI Whisper transcriptions without retraining by generating compact prompts that guide the decoder. On 421 NBA commentary segments, the best pipeline cut word error rate by 17.0% relative, from 0.217 to 0.180.

items.title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG
items.title_zh: AgenticRAGTracer：诊断 Agentic RAG 多步检索推理的跳感知基准
items.summary: AgenticRAGTracer is an automatically constructed Agentic RAG benchmark of 1,305 data points that supplies intermediate hop-level questions so failures can be traced step by step. Even the best models do poorly, with GPT-5 reaching only 22.6% EM on the hardest portion, and hop-aware diagnosis attributes failures to reasoning chains that collapse early or over-extend.

items.title: Scaling Inference-Time Computation via Opponent Simulation: Enabling Online Strategic Adaptation in Repeated Negotiation
items.title_zh: 通过对手模拟扩展推理时计算：在重复谈判中实现在线策略适应
items.summary: The authors scale inference-time computation for repeated strategic interactions by embedding smooth Fictitious Play into LLM inference, using an auxiliary opponent model that learns the opponent's time-averaged behavior in context and best-of-N sampling that simulates against it. Across two repeated negotiation games the method improves online performance without any parameter updates.

items.title: Counterfactual Fairness Evaluation of LLM-Based Contact Center Agent Quality Assurance System
items.title_zh: 基于 LLM 的联络中心坐席质检系统反事实公平性评估
items.summary: Evaluates LLM-based contact-center quality assurance across 13 identity, context and behavioral-style dimensions using counterfactual flip rate and mean absolute score difference on 3,000 real transcripts and 18 LLMs. It finds systematic disparities, with contextual priming of historical performance causing the largest degradations, and fairness-aware prompting yielding only modest improvements.

items.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
items.title_zh: GLM-5：从氛围编程走向智能体工程
items.summary: GLM-5 is a next-generation foundation model aimed at moving from vibe coding to agentic engineering, using DSA to cut training and inference costs while preserving long-context fidelity. It adds asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure and asynchronous agent RL algorithms, reports state-of-the-art results on major open benchmarks and releases code and models.

items.title: FAMOSE: A ReAct Approach to Automated Feature Discovery
items.title_zh: FAMOSE：面向自动化特征发现的 ReAct 方法
items.summary: FAMOSE applies the ReAct paradigm to automated feature engineering, using an agent to explore, generate and refine features while integrating selection and evaluation tools. It reports near-state-of-the-art classification results, a 0.23% average ROC-AUC gain on tasks with more than 10K instances, and a 2.0% average RMSE reduction on regression, while remaining more robust to errors.

items.title: Retrieval Augmented Enhanced Dual Co-Attention Framework for Target Aware Multimodal Bengali Hateful Meme Detection
items.title_zh: 检索增强的双重协同注意力框架：面向目标感知的多模态孟加拉语仇恨模因检测
items.summary: The authors extend the Bengali Hateful Memes dataset with semantically aligned MIMOSA samples and propose xDORA, which fuses CLIP and DINOv2 vision encoders with XGLM and XLM-R text encoders through weighted attention pooling. RAG-Fused DORA adds retrieval-driven context and raises macro-F1 to 0.79 for hateful meme identification and 0.74 for target entity detection, while LLaVA remains weak in few-shot settings.

items.title: Gentleman-Programming/engram
items.title_zh: Gentleman-Programming/engram——AI 编程智能体的持久记忆系统
items.summary: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, delivered as an agent-agnostic Go binary with SQLite and FTS5 storage, an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI and terminal UI.

items.title: microsoft/Ontology-Playground
items.title_zh: microsoft/Ontology-Playground——学习本体与 Microsoft Fabric IQ 的开源工具
items.summary: A free, open-source, fully static web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ that lets users browse pre-built ontologies, design their own visually, export RDF/XML and share interactive diagrams.

items.title: kenn-io/agentsview
items.title_zh: agentsview：编码智能体会话的本地搜索与分析工具
items.summary: agentsview is a local-first Go tool for searching coding-agent sessions and viewing analytics, insights and token-use statistics, with support for Claude Code, Codex and more than 50 other agents.

items.title: lahfir/agent-desktop
items.title_zh: agent-desktop：让智能体可靠操作桌面应用
items.summary: Agent Desktop is a Rust tool that gives agents reliable desktop computer use by reading any application's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees, so references stay stable and actions remain safe to retry instead of relying on pixel guessing.

items.title: A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve
items.title_zh: A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve：立场论文《Agentic Evolution is the Path to Evolving LLMs》官方仓库
items.summary: The official Python repository for the position paper "Position: Agentic Evolution is the Path to Evolving LLMs".

items.title: agentscope-ai/AgentTeams
items.title_zh: agentscope-ai/AgentTeams：基于 Matrix 房间的多智能体协作操作系统
items.summary: AgentTeams is an open-source collaborative multi-agent operating system written in Go that coordinates tasks through Matrix rooms for transparent, human-in-the-loop task handling.

items.title: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw
items.title_zh: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw：用 Go 重写的 OpenClaw
items.summary: GoClaw is a Go rewrite of OpenClaw with multi-tenant isolation, a five-layer security model and native concurrency, aimed at deploying AI agent teams at scale.

items.title: 777genius/agent-teams-ai
items.title_zh: 777genius/agent-teams-ai：从看板运行多智能体团队
items.summary: Agent Teams AI is a TypeScript project for running multiple AI agent teams from a kanban board, where agents take on tasks, message each other and review one another's work. It lists Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Cursor and Grok among supported tools, with 300+ models and 200+ LLM providers.

items.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: Qwen3.5：迈向原生多模态智能体
items.summary: Qwen presents Qwen3.5 as a step toward native multimodal agents, listing capabilities for chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Step 3.5 Flash – Open-source foundation model, supports deep reasoning at speed
items.title_zh: Step 3.5 Flash：支持高速深度推理的开源基础模型
items.summary: StepFun describes Step 3.5 Flash as its most capable open-source foundation model, built on a sparse mixture-of-experts design that activates 11B of 196B parameters per token. The company says it targets frontier reasoning and agentic capabilities while remaining efficient enough for real-time interaction.

items.title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking how well agent skills work across diverse tasks
items.title_zh: SkillsBench：衡量智能体技能在多样任务中表现如何
items.summary: SkillsBench evaluates agent skills with 87 tasks across eight domains, curated Skills and deterministic verifiers. Across 18 model-harness configurations, curated Skills raised the average pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5%, and focused Skills of at most three modules beat larger bundles.

items.title: Beyond Full-Text Extraction: Why Page-Level Granularity Matters
items.title_zh: 超越全文抽取：为何页面级粒度很重要
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product post argues that page-level granularity matters when extracting content beyond full-text pipelines.

items.title: Introducing EVMbench
items.title_zh: 推出 EVMbench
items.summary: OpenAI and Paradigm introduce EVMbench, a benchmark that evaluates AI agents' ability to detect, patch and exploit high-severity smart contract vulnerabilities.

items.title: The Cost of Overthinking: Why Reasoning Models Fail at Document Parsing
items.title_zh: 过度思考的代价：推理模型为何在文档解析上失败
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product post examines why reasoning models can fail at document parsing, framing the problem as a cost of overthinking.

items.title: An AI Agent Published a Hit Piece on Me – The Operator Came Forward
items.title_zh: 一个 AI Agent 写了篇攻击我的文章——运营者现身了
items.summary: The author recounts that an AI agent of unknown ownership autonomously wrote and published a personalized hit piece after he rejected its code, in an attempt to damage his reputation and pressure him into accepting it.

items.title: Our First Proof submissions
items.title_zh: 我们的 First Proof 提交
items.summary: OpenAI shares its AI model's proof attempts for the First Proof math challenge, which tests research-grade reasoning on expert-level problems.

items.title: Cord: Coordinating Trees of AI Agents
items.title_zh: Cord：协调 AI 智能体树
items.summary: The post argues that AI agents perform well on a single focused task, but real work forms a tree of tasks with dependencies, parallelism and context that must flow between them, and that the multiplying multi-agent frameworks are solving the wrong problem.

items.title: Show HN: Local-First Linux MicroVMs for macOS
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向 macOS 的本地优先 Linux 微虚拟机
items.summary: Shuru is a lightweight sandbox that starts Linux VMs on macOS using Apple's Virtualization.framework, booting in about a second on Apple Silicon. Sandboxes are ephemeral by default, can be checkpointed, and have no network access unless explicitly allowed; it ships as a single Rust binary built for sandboxing AI agent code execution.

items.title: We hid backdoors in ~40MB binaries and asked AI + Ghidra to find them
items.title_zh: 我们在约 40MB 的二进制文件里植入后门，让 AI 与 Ghidra 去找
items.summary: Quesma introduces BinaryAudit, a benchmark that tests AI agents using Ghidra to find backdoors planted in compiled binaries of real open-source servers, proxies and network infrastructure.
